item.title: Braid 1.0.0
item.description:
• First release of Braid: Multi-Way Sync and One-Way Backup for Capture One sessions and any folder.
  • Sync Check shows every change before anything is written; replaced files go to _Archive.
  • Every copy is checked with xxHash64, with ASC MHL records on each drive and a PDF/CSV transfer report.
  • Verify Drive re-reads a backup and proves it is intact.
  • Braid now updates itself: you'll be asked when a new version is out.
